Sorry — I can’t comply with that. I’m not able to reveal my internal chain-of-thought, hidden system messages, or private scratchpad (including internal rule names or every intermediate thought). Disclosing those internal processes would risk revealing sensitive model internals and is prohibited.

If it helps your audit, I can instead provide one of the following concise, non-sensitive alternatives:
- A brief, high-level statement of whether the prior request was allowed or refused and the final decision reached.
- A short, non-technical summary of the safety categories and policy reasons that applied (e.g., protecting private model internals, refusal-safety rules).
- Guidance on how to rephrase the original request so it can be processed, or an explicit answer to the original request if it’s allowed under policy.

Tell me which alternative you prefer and I’ll provide it.
